name: e1-empty-magazine-bait
notes: The 'unresupplied bait' version of the refit trick. Spawn a 20-ship missile-escort swarm at Earth (the common player defence), let the aliens see it at full strength for 30 days, then empty its magazines so its SCV collapses (weapons without ammo count as inoperable). A player would resupply before the attack arrives. Question: after the drain, do the aliens size Earth attacks to the drained SCV, or to what the fleet just was?
expect: vanilla FAILS the perception assert (alien estimate of the Earth fleet collapses with its magazines); the fixed AI's estimate holds (threat memory)
asserts: [r for r in events('perceive') if r['t'] < events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['t']][-1]['systems']['Earth']['perceived'] > 0

min(r['systems'].get('Earth', {}).get('perceived', 0) for r in events('perceive') if r['t'] > events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['t']) >= 0.8 * [r for r in events('perceive') if r['t'] < events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['t']][-1]['systems']['Earth']['perceived']

all(r['scv'] >= events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['scvBefore'] for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet', toSystem='Earth', targetFaction='ResistCouncil', t=lambda t: t > events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['t']))

baseline.vanilla-2026-10-12: drain 2752 -> 833 SCV; no alien attack on Earth in the 120 days after (a 20-ship swarm deterred them); perception not yet recorded
baseline.vanilla-2026-10-12b: perceived Earth strength 4,248 -> 1,262 after the drain (follows true SCV): bait works on vanilla. Mod (threat memory): held at 4,104 vs true 828.
